name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Add opt-in friends-of-friends federation: with the new 'Allow friends-of-friends' setting on, this server asks its friends who their other friends are and automatically sends friend requests to anyone new it discovers (still needs their admin to accept). Off by default. Content stays scoped to what a server actually owns either way - it never re-shares content that was itself federated into it from someone else.
